definition_zh: 学位论文；论点；论题；命题
definition_en: a long research essay submitted for a university degree, or a proposition put forward for argument
core_image: 一叠装订好的论文放在答辩桌上，封面印着标题与作者名
scene: 答辩室里，学生把装订好的论文递给评审，然后开始陈述自己的核心论点。In the defence room, the student handed the bound thesis to the examiners and then stated the central claim.
sceneCN: 这里 thesis 是「学位论文」（第 1 个义项：为取得学位而提交的研究长文）；句意：答辩室里，学生把装订好的论文递给评审，然后陈述核心论点。

derivatives.zh: 对立面；反题，由 anti-（相反）加 thesis 构成
假设；假说，由 hypo-（在下）加 thesis 构成，字面义为「放在下面的命题」
正题的；直陈的，由 thesis 加 -tic 构成

senses.title: A degree dissertation
senses.definition: a long piece of writing based on research, submitted for a university degree
senses.definitionCN: 基于研究写成、为取得大学学位而提交的长篇论文
senses.example: She spent two years collecting data for her doctoral thesis.
senses.exampleCN: 她花了两年时间为博士论文收集数据。
senses.why: The Greek word for a placing became the written work that a candidate lays before examiners.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语中「放置」这个词，变成了候选人摆到评审面前的那部长篇作品。

senses.title: The central claim
senses.definition: the main claim that an essay or a talk sets out to prove
senses.definitionCN: 文章或演讲试图证明的核心主张
senses.example: The thesis of the article is that remote work changes office life.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇文章的中心论点是远程工作改变了办公室生活。
senses.why: A thesis is a proposition laid down, so it also names the claim a writer places at the centre.
senses.whyCN: thesis 本是被放下的命题，因此也指作者摆到文章中心的那条主张。

senses.title: A proposition for argument
senses.definition: a statement put forward for discussion and proof
senses.definitionCN: 提出来供讨论并加以证明的陈述
senses.example: The debate class tested each thesis with evidence and counterexamples.
senses.exampleCN: 辩论课用证据和反例逐一检验每个命题。
senses.why: Logic kept the original sense of a proposition placed for argument.
senses.whyCN: 逻辑学保留了原义：一条被摆出来、等待论证的命题。

senses.title: The first term in dialectic
senses.definition: the first proposition in a dialectical pattern, which is answered by an antithesis
senses.definitionCN: 辩证模式中的第一个命题，由反题来回应
senses.example: In the Hegelian pattern, the thesis is met by an antithesis and resolved in a synthesis.
senses.exampleCN: 在黑格尔式模式中，正题遭遇反题，并在合题中得到解决。
senses.why: Philosophy used the placing image for the first term that is set down before its opposite.
senses.whyCN: 哲学用「放置」的意象指先被放下、随后遭遇对立面的第一个命题。

senses.title: A stressed beat in music
senses.definition: the strong beat of a bar, on which the movement of a phrase lands
senses.definitionCN: 小节中的强拍，乐句的运动在此落定
senses.example: The conductor marked the thesis with a firm downward stroke.
senses.exampleCN: 指挥用一个有力的下压动作标出强拍。
senses.why: Greek metrics called the placing of the foot on the beat a thesis, and music kept the downbeat image.
senses.whyCN: 希腊韵律学把脚落在拍点上称为 thesis，音乐则保留了这个「落拍」意象。

intro.en: Thesis comes from Greek thesis, a placing or a proposition, from tithenai, to place or put.
intro.cn: thesis 来自希腊语 thesis（放置、命题），源于 tithenai（放置、安放）。

items.en: Tithenai means to place or to put something down.
items.cn: tithenai 意为放置、把某物放下。

items.en: Thesis means a placing, and then a proposition laid down.
items.cn: thesis 意为放置，进而指被放下的命题。

items.en: Latin borrows thesis for a proposition and for a stressed beat.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入 thesis，用来指命题与强拍。

items.en: English thesis first names a proposition in logic and learning.
items.cn: 英语 thesis 最早指逻辑与学术中的命题。

items.en: The word extends to a subject laid out for formal debate.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到为正式辩论而摆出的论题。

items.en: Thesis becomes the long research essay submitted for a degree.
items.cn: 现代英语中，thesis 指为取得学位而提交的研究长文。

note.en: Thesis is the Greek placing word behind antithesis and hypothesis, and it sits near dissertation, essay, and argument.
note.cn: thesis 是希腊语「放置」词，构成 antithesis 与 hypothesis，并与 dissertation、essay、argument 意义相邻。

entries.definition: the opposite proposition in a dialectical pair
entries.definitionCN: 辩证配对中的反题；对立面

entries.definition: a supposition put forward as a starting point
entries.definitionCN: 作为出发点提出的假设

entries.definition: a long research essay written for a degree
entries.definitionCN: 为取得学位而写的长篇研究论文，与 thesis 的论文义接近

entries.definition: a short piece of writing on a subject
entries.definitionCN: 短文；随笔，篇幅通常比 thesis 短

entries.definition: a set of reasons offered for a claim
entries.definitionCN: 论证；说理，对应 thesis 的论点义

normalIntro.en: Thesis comes from Greek tithenai, to place, so a thesis is a claim placed before readers.
normalIntro.cn: thesis 来自希腊语 tithenai（放置），所以论文与论点都是摆到读者面前的东西。

normal.en: Thesis and tithenai share the Greek image of placing something down.
normal.cn: thesis 与 tithenai 共享希腊语「把东西放下」的意象。

normal.en: A doctoral thesis is the long work a candidate places before examiners.
normal.cn: 博士论文是候选人摆到评审面前的长篇作品。

normal.en: The thesis statement tells the reader what the essay will prove.
normal.cn: 论点陈述告诉读者这篇文章要证明什么。

normal.en: To defend a thesis is to answer the questions of the examiners.
normal.cn: 进行论文答辩，就是回答评审提出的问题。

normal.en: Compare dissertation: dissertation is the book, thesis can also be the claim.
normal.cn: 对比 dissertation：dissertation 指那本书，thesis 还可以指书中的主张。

abstract.en: Picture a bound volume placed on a defence table.
abstract.cn: 想象一本装订好的论文放在答辩桌上。

abstract.en: Picture one sentence underlined at the top of a page.
abstract.cn: 想象一页纸的顶端有一句话被画了下划线。

abstract.en: Picture a stone marker set down on a debate table.
abstract.cn: 想象一块石制标记被放在辩论桌上。

examples.en: Her thesis examines how students learn to write academic English.
examples.cn: 她的论文研究学生如何学习学术英语写作。

examples.en: The supervisor asked him to state the thesis in one sentence.
examples.cn: 导师让他用一句话说清中心论点。

examples.en: Several theses in the library cover the same period of history.
examples.cn: 图书馆里有好几篇论文研究同一段历史。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「西塞斯」——西施把论文塞进书桌；谐音联想，不是词源。

root: 希腊语 tithenai（放置）→ thesis（放置；被放下的命题）→ 拉丁语 thesis → 英语 thesis，核心义「把主张摆出来、放下」。

sensesIntro.en: Thesis moves from the act of placing to the claim placed before readers, then to the degree essay, the dialectical first term, and the musical downbeat.
sensesIntro.cn: thesis 从「放置」这一动作，转到摆到读者面前的论点，再引申为学位论文、辩证法正题与音乐强拍。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bound dissertation laid on the table of a defence room.
core.cn: 核心意象：一本装订好的论文放在答辩室的桌上。

branches.en: The degree dissertation is the main academic sense.
branches.cn: 学位论文是主要的学术义项。

branches.en: The central claim is the essay sense.
branches.cn: 中心论点是文章层面的义项。

branches.en: The proposition for argument is the logical sense.
branches.cn: 待论证命题是逻辑义项。

branches.en: The dialectical first term is the philosophical sense.
branches.cn: 辩证法正题是哲学义项。

branches.en: The stressed beat is the musical sense.

intro.en: Thesis is built on Greek tithenai, to place, with the action-noun ending -sis; antithesis and hypothesis are the same root with different prefixes.
intro.cn: thesis 建在希腊语 tithenai（放置）之上，动作名词词尾 -sis 使其成为「放置」这一行为；antithesis 与 hypothesis 则是换用不同前缀的同根词。

latinIntro.en: Greek tithenai means to place, thesis means a placing or proposition, and Latin borrowed thesis with both senses.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 tithenai 意为放置，thesis 意为放置或命题，拉丁语把这两个含义一并借入。

items.example: Tithenai is the verb behind thesis.
items.exampleCN: tithenai 是 thesis 背后的动词。

items.example: Greek thesis joins the placing action with a claim.
items.exampleCN: 希腊语 thesis 把放置动作与主张连在一起。

items.example: Latin thesis keeps the proposition and the beat.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语 thesis 保留命题与强拍两个含义。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或过程的名词词尾
items.example: The ending -sis turns a verb of placing into a noun.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -sis 把「放置」动词变成名词。

items.meaning: a placing against, the opposite proposition
items.example: Antithesis sets a second claim against the first.
items.exampleCN: antithesis 把第二个主张放到第一个的对面。

items.example: Hypothesis places a starting claim under an inquiry.
items.exampleCN: hypothesis 把一个起点主张放在探究之下。

items.example: Synthesis places the two sides together.
items.exampleCN: synthesis 把两面放到一起。

items.example: Parenthesis places extra words beside the main line.
items.exampleCN: parenthesis 把额外的词放在主线旁边。

items.example: Thetic describes a claim laid down without opposition.
items.exampleCN: thetic 描述未经对立就直接放下的主张。

items.meaning: a degree essay or a claim
items.example: English thesis keeps the essay and the claim.
items.exampleCN: 英语 thesis 同时保留论文与论点两个含义。

definition_en: a reference to a source, an official summons to appear in court, or a formal mention of merit
core_image: 一根手指指向摊开的书页，旁边写下一行出处
scene: 法庭书记员把传票递给证人，要求他按时出庭作证。The court clerk handed the citation to the witness and told him to appear on time.
sceneCN: 这里 citation 是「传票」（第 3 个义项：法院传唤某人出庭的正式命令）；句意：书记员把传票递给证人，要求他按时出庭。

derivatives.zh: 引用；引证；传唤，是 citation 的动词形式
可引用的，由 cite 加 -able 构成
引用者，由 cite 加 -er 构成

senses.title: A quoted passage
senses.definition: a group of words taken from a book or a speech and used in another text
senses.definitionCN: 从书籍或演讲中取出、用于另一篇文字的一段话
senses.example: The opening citation from the poem sets the tone of the chapter.
senses.exampleCN: 开篇引用的诗句为这一章定下基调。
senses.why: Citare means to call, so a citation calls the words of another writer into a new text.
senses.whyCN: citare 意为召唤，所以引文就是把别人的话叫进自己的文章里。

senses.title: The act of referring
senses.definition: the act of referring to a source in support of an argument
senses.definitionCN: 为支持论点而提及来源的行为
senses.example: Proper citation allows readers to check every claim.
senses.exampleCN: 规范的引用让读者能够核查每一个论断。
senses.why: The act sense names the calling itself, not only the words that are called.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项指「召唤」这个动作本身，而不只是被叫来的那些文字。

senses.title: A court summons
senses.definition: an official order summoning someone to appear in court
senses.definitionCN: 法院传唤某人出庭的正式命令
senses.example: The court issued a citation to the witness who failed to appear.
senses.exampleCN: 法院向未能出庭的证人发出了传票。
senses.why: The oldest English sense is legal: a citation calls a person to court.
senses.whyCN: 英语里最古老的义项是法律义：传票把一个人叫到法庭上。

senses.title: An official commendation
senses.definition: an official mention of someone brave or successful, especially in the armed forces
senses.definitionCN: 对英勇或有功者的官方表扬，尤指军队中的嘉奖
senses.example: The soldier received a citation for rescuing two civilians.
senses.exampleCN: 这名士兵因救出两名平民而获得嘉奖。
senses.why: A citation can also call attention to merit, a formal public naming of good service.
senses.whyCN: citation 也可以把功劳叫到公众面前，于是引申为对良好表现的正式公开表彰。

senses.title: A supporting example
senses.definition: a mention of a person or a case as an example or a proof
senses.definitionCN: 把某人或某案例作为例证或证据提出来
senses.example: The report includes a citation of two earlier studies on the same problem.
senses.exampleCN: 报告援引了两项研究同一问题的早期成果。
senses.why: Reference to a case or an authority is another way of calling it in as support.
senses.whyCN: 提及某个案例或权威，是把它叫进来充当支撑的另一种方式。

senses.title: A reference entry
senses.definition: the details of a source listed at the end of a text
senses.definitionCN: 列在文章末尾的出处信息
senses.example: Every citation in the list gives the author, the title, and the year.
senses.exampleCN: 列表中的每一条参考文献都给出作者、标题和年份。
senses.why: Modern publishing turns the calling into a fixed entry that lets a reader find the source.
senses.whyCN: 现代出版把「召唤」固定成条目，读者据此可以找到原始出处。

intro.en: Citation comes from Latin citatio, a summons, from citare, to summon, a frequentative of ciere, to set in motion or call.
intro.cn: citation 来自拉丁语 citatio（传唤），源于 citare（传唤），而 citare 是 ciere（使动、召唤）的反复动词。

items.en: Ciere means to set in motion or to call.
items.cn: ciere 意为使动、唤起或召唤。

items.en: Citare, its frequentative, means to summon or to call repeatedly.
items.cn: citare 是它的反复动词，意为传唤、反复召唤。

items.en: Citatio names a summons to appear.
Citation carries the summons sense into French.
items.cn: citation 把传唤义带入法语。

items.en: English citation first means a summons to a court.
items.cn: 英语 citation 最早指法院传唤。

items.en: The word extends to quotations, reference entries, and awards.
items.cn: 这个词后来扩展到引文、参考文献条目与嘉奖。

note.en: Citation belongs to the Latin calling family of cite, citable, and recitation, and it sits near quotation, reference, and summons.
note.cn: citation 属于拉丁语「召唤」词族，与 cite、citable、recitation 同源，并与 quotation、reference、summons 意义相邻。

entries.definition: to quote a source or to summon someone
the act of reciting words aloud
entries.definitionCN: 背诵；朗诵，与 citation 同出 citare

entries.definition: a group of words repeated from a source
entries.definitionCN: 引语；引用的话，强调被重复的那段文字

entries.definition: a mention of a source or a piece of information
entries.definitionCN: 提及；参考出处，范围比 citation 更宽

entries.definition: an official order to appear in court
entries.definitionCN: 传票；传唤令，与 citation 的法律义接近

normalIntro.en: Citation and cite share the Latin verb citare, to summon or to call.
normalIntro.cn: citation 与 cite 同出拉丁语 citare（召唤、传唤）。

normal.en: Citation and cite share the Latin verb citare, to summon.
normal.cn: citation 与 cite 同出拉丁语 citare（召唤）。

normal.en: A citation in a paper calls a source to stand as evidence.
normal.cn: 论文中的引用把某个出处叫来充当证据。

normal.en: Citation style fixes the order of author, title, and year.
normal.cn: 引用格式固定作者、标题与年份的排列顺序。

normal.en: A traffic citation is a ticket that calls a driver to answer for a fault.
normal.cn: 交通罚单是一张叫司机为违规作出回应的票。

normal.en: Compare quotation: a quotation is the words, a citation is the reference to their source.
normal.cn: 对比 quotation：quotation 是被引的文字，citation 是对出处的指认。

abstract.en: Picture a hand beckoning words out of an open book.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手从摊开的书里把文字招出来。

abstract.en: Picture a name called across a crowded room.
abstract.cn: 想象一个名字在拥挤的房间里被叫起。

abstract.en: Picture a sealed summons lying on a table.
abstract.cn: 想象一张封好的传票放在桌上。

examples.en: Each citation must match the style guide of the journal.
examples.cn: 每条引用都必须符合该期刊的格式指南。

examples.en: The court citation ordered the company to appear next month.
examples.cn: 法院传票命令该公司下月出庭。

examples.en: The officer wrote a citation for the car parked in the wrong place.
examples.cn: 警官给停错位置的汽车开了一张罚单。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「塞太申」——把引文塞进正文，还要注明出处；谐音联想，不是词源。

root: 拉丁语 ciere（唤起、召唤）→ citare（召唤、引用）→ citatio（传唤）→ 古法语 citation → 英语 citation，核心义「把某人或某句话叫出来作证」。

sensesIntro.en: Citation starts as a court summons, then becomes the act of calling a source, the quoted words, the supporting example, the reference entry, and an award.
sensesIntro.cn: citation 从法院传唤出发，引申为召唤出处的行为、被引的文字、援引的例证、参考文献条目以及嘉奖。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a finger pointing at a line in an open book.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根手指指向摊开书页上的一行字。

branches.en: The quoted passage is the textual sense.
branches.cn: 引文是文本层面的义项。

branches.en: The act of referring is the process sense.
The court summons is the oldest legal sense.
branches.cn: 法院传票是最古老的法律义项。

branches.en: The commendation is the public honour sense.
Supporting examples and reference entries both point readers to a source.
branches.cn: 援引例证与参考文献条目都把读者指向某个出处。

intro.en: Citation is built on Latin citare, to summon, with the noun ending -ation; cite and citable show the same root in English.
intro.cn: citation 建在拉丁语 citare（召唤）之上，名词词尾 -ation 使其成为行为或结果；cite 与 citable 是英语中同根的动词与形容词。

latinIntro.en: Latin ciere means to call, citare means to summon, and citatio means a summons.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ciere 意为召唤，citare 意为传唤，citatio 意为传唤。

items.meaning: to set in motion, to call
items.example: Ciere is the short verb at the root.
items.exampleCN: ciere 是词根处的简短动词。

items.example: Citare is the frequentative of ciere.
items.exampleCN: citare 是 ciere 的反复动词。

items.example: Citatio names the legal call to appear.
items.exampleCN: citatio 指传唤出庭这一法律行为。

items.meaningCN: 表示行为或结果的名词词尾
items.example: The ending -ation forms citation from citare.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ation 让 citare 构成 citation。

items.example: Citation keeps the calling image in modern English.
items.exampleCN: citation 在现代英语中保留「召唤」意象。

items.example: Cite is the short English verb of the family.
items.exampleCN: cite 是这个词族里简短的英语动词。

items.example: Citable adds the adjective suffix -able.
items.exampleCN: citable 加了形容词后缀 -able。

items.example: Citer adds the agent suffix -er.
items.exampleCN: citer 加了施事后缀 -er。

items.example: Recitation repeats the root with the prefix re-.
items.exampleCN: recitation 用前缀 re- 重复了同一词根。

items.meaningCN: 表示「可以被……」的形容词后缀
items.example: The suffix -able forms citable from cite.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -able 让 cite 构成 citable。
